TextSection.Contents: A form of heterotaxy characterized by both atrial appendages having the morphology of a left atrial appendage often associated with two morphologically left lungs and/or bronchi and polysplenia. Associated cardiovascular defects are frequent including common atrioventricular junction (atrioventricular septal defect) anomalous systemic (interrupted caval vein with azygos continuation) or pulmonary (ipsilateral venous return) venous connections. Cardiac arrhythmias and atrioventricular block are frequently observed. Typical extracardiac anomalies are midline liver intestinal malrotation and biliary atresia.
